index.intro: This whole website was made with Friendly Frame, a small static site generator and web framework. Each section below shows one of its features: the result, what was written in edit-me/, and what that got compiled into in actual-website-do-not-edit/.
index.reusables_live: These two author cards are the same reusable element, each given a different picture. The top bar of this page is one too.
index.reusables_text: Write something once in edit-me/shared/reusables/ (its .scss and .ts get linked automatically), add it to the compilation order below anything it uses, then use it on any page with one tag. {x} becomes the value you give it, [x] a name made from that file name, @template:x another reusable element, and @none: nothing.
index.ts_live: This year, worked out by index.js in your browser:
index.ts_text: In any .ts file, <r-currentYear> is replaced with edit-me/shared/code/currentYear.ts.
index.paths_live: This blog post is one folder down, but still loads the same stylesheet, through ../shared/global.css:
index.paths_text: <root> becomes the path back to the root of the website, from wherever the file ends up.
index.text_live: Switch language: everything except the code changes, and you stay at the same place on the page.
index.text_text: Text goes in edit-me/shared/page_text/, one file per language. Each page gets compiled once per language, and index.html gets the default language (en).
index.blogs_live: The blog posts, each only three lines long:
index.blogs_text: Any page that ends up in actual-website-do-not-edit/blog/ only needs its content: the rest of the page comes from the two blog templates.
